title: Greedy matching with two sorted lists

steps.caption: Assign Cookies: sort children by greed and cookies by size. Give each child the smallest cookie that satisfies them.
Cookie 1 ≥ greed 1: give it. Using the SMALLEST cookie that works keeps bigger ones for greedier children.
Cookie 1 < greed 2: too small for this child, and for every greedier child too. Throw it away.
Cookie 3 ≥ greed 2: give it. Using the SMALLEST cookie that works keeps bigger ones for greedier children.
2 children content. Exchange argument: giving a bigger cookie to an easy child can never help, so the greedy choice is safe.
